title.value: Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Parameterized Action Spaces

abstract.value: We propose a novel model-based reinforcement learning algorithm---Dynamics Learning and predictive control with Parameterized Actions (DLPA)---for Parameterized Action Markov Decision Processes (PAMDPs). The agent learns a parameterized-action-conditioned dynamics model and plans with a modified Model Predictive Path Integral control. Our empirical results on several standard benchmarks show that our algorithm achieves superior sample efficiency and asymptotic performance than state-of-the-art PAMDP methods.
